title: Concatenation of Guarded Runs with Two Outputs
statement: Fix a memory machine, oracle, input, and guard predicate. If a configuration $a$ reaches $b$ in finitely many steps with the guard holding at every time strictly before arrival, and there exist $y,z$ such that $b$ reaches $f(y,z)$ with the guard holding at every time strictly before arrival and $Q(y,z)$, then there exist $y,z$ such that $a$ reaches $f(y,z)$ with the guard holding at every time strictly before arrival and $Q(y,z)$.
hypotheses_covered: A guarded finite run from $a$ to $b$
There exist $y,z$ with a guarded finite run from $b$ to $f(y,z)$ and $Q(y,z)$
replaced:
Fix the machine, oracle, input, and guard condition. If a configuration $a$ reaches $b$
in finitely many steps while satisfying the guard at every time strictly before arrival,
and there are $y,z$ such that $b$ similarly reaches $f(y,z)$ and $Q(y,z)$ holds, then
there are $y,z$ such that $a$ similarly reaches $f(y,z)$ and $Q(y,z)$ holds.
